title: Oppression & suppression
tldr: Focus, focus, focus... the kernel is noisy, listening is essential.
contents: When under load, an adversary can create an oppresive environment, the countermeasures require suppression.
In the words of Tyler Durden, 'Stop trying to control everything, and just let go. Let go!'
The only way to ensure a laser focus is achieved, dropping eBPF kernel events en masse in order to shift focus on those that matter.
A sequence is going to be required to ensure traceability at the same time. Working through the noise...
